Join the Veldhorst Group, pioneers in germanium-based quantum computing and simulation. Job description 
After a successful first hire for this research topic, we are looking for a second Postdoctoral Researcher to join the Veldhorst Group, who are pioneers in quantum computing and simulation in germanium. The Veldhorst group demonstrated the first single-hole qubit, enabled two-qubit logic in germanium, and executed quantum algorithms on a four-qubit quantum processor. 
As a Postdoc researcher, you will explore opportunities with semiconductor quantum technology and aim to push the boundaries in quantum control of semiconductor qubits. 
The Veldhorst group is a collaborative and supportive research environment where team members work closely together, share expertise, and mentor one another while advancing the field of semiconductor quantum technology. 
Near-term projects include multi-qubit operation, entanglement generation between qubit registers, and multi-quantum wells for higher dimensional quantum systems. Requirements 
You have a PhD degree in physics, applied physics, nanoelectronics or comparable discipline at the time of taking on the position. Prior experience in solid-state quantum computing, spin qubits, or superconducting qubits would be beneficial but is not required. 
Doing a Postdoc at TU Delft requires English proficiency at a certain level to ensure that the candidate is able to communicate and interact well, participate in English-taught Doctoral Education courses, and write scientific articles and a final thesis. For more details please check the Graduate Schools Admission Requirements.

As Office & Client Support Officer, you are the face of Scotch Whisky Investments. With warmth, professionalism, and an eye for detail, you ensure every visit to our Sassenheim office is a memorable experience. 
Your Role 
As Office & Client Support Officer, you are the first impression clients and investors have of SWI, and the organisational link between front office, Client Experience, and Sales. You welcome visitors and investors in a friendly and professional manner and manage inbound and outbound mail. You prepare and serve beverages for guests and ensure the reception, kitchen, bar, and guest areas are always immaculate and inviting. 
Beyond day-to-day hospitality, you support SWI's internal events, from meetings to client gatherings and exclusive whisky tastings, and provide administrative support to the Client Experience and Sales teams. 
In this role, you combine a strong service mindset with organisational skills and a polished, professional presentation. You are detail-oriented, flexible, and at ease in a dynamic, international environment. 
Your Experience 
● Minimum MBO level, preferably in administration, communication, reception, or hospitality 
● 1-3 years of experience in a customer service, receptionist, front office, or administrative role 
● Experience in a luxury or premium service environment is a plus 
● Fluent in both Dutch and English (spoken and written) 
● Proficient in Microsoft 365 (Outlook, Word, Excel, calendar management) 
● Professional attitude with a strong sense of etiquette and discretion 
● Service-oriented, organised, detail-focused, hands-on, and proactive 
● Flexible and willing to support events outside regular office hours when needed
